title: Video Editing And Graphic Designer
description:
JobShop is a recruitment company specialising in BPO and customer support hiring. We are looking for a creative and energetic Video Editor & Content Creator who can help us build our brand presence across social media platforms through engaging videos, reels, and digital content. 
 As a Video Editor, you will work across events, brands, social media, podcasts, interviews, corporate content and digital campaigns. 
 We are looking for someone who doesnt just know how to edit but understands storytelling, pacing, music, emotion and what makes people stop scrolling. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and social media videos Edit event aftermovies, highlights and recap videos Edit interviews, podcasts and corporate videos Create engaging short-form content from long-form footage Add music, sound effects, captions, transitions and motion graphics Perform basic colour correction and audio enhancement Create videos according to brand guidelines Work with the creative and events teams to understand the objective of each video Select the best footage and create a strong narrative Handle multiple projects and meet tight deadlines Make revisions based on client and internal feedback Organise and manage video footage and project files efficiently 
 Tools Required 
 Must have: 
 * Adobe Premiere Pro * Adobe After Effects * CapCut 
 Good to have: 
 * Adobe Photoshop * Adobe Audition * DaVinci Resolve * Canva * Frame.io 
 AI tools / emerging technology added advantage: 
 * Runway * Adobe Firefly * Descript * ElevenLabs * OpusClip 
 Skills We Are Looking For 
 * Strong storytelling ability * Excellent sense of timing and pacing * Understanding of social media trends * Good eye for visuals and composition * Strong music sense * Attention to detail * Ability to create strong hooks in the first few seconds * Understanding of typography and motion graphics * Ability to work under tight deadlines * Ability to take feedback positively and make quick changes * Good communication and teamwork * Ability to work independently and take ownership 
 The Most Important Skill 
 Don’t just be an editor. Be a storyteller. 
 We want someone who can look at 2 hours of footage and understand: 
 What is the story? What should people see? What should they feel? And why should they keep watching? 
 Experience 
 1–3 years of relevant experience preferred. 
 Freshers with an exceptional portfolio and strong editing skills may also apply. 
 Experience in events, advertising, branded content, digital media or social media will be an advantage. 
 What We Expect 
 * Creativity * Speed * Ownership * Curiosity * Attention to detail * Willingness to experiment * Ability to handle multiple deadlines 
 Practical Test 
 Shortlisted candidates will be given raw footage and asked to create a 30-second social media Reel. 
 We will evaluate: 
 * Storytelling * Hook * Editing * Music * Pacing * Visual creativity * Captions * Overall impact 
 Location :Bengaluru 
 Employment / Full-time 
 Apply 
 Please share your CV + portfolio/showreel + links to 3 of your best social media videos.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Job Title: Graphic Designer and Video Editor Location: Chennai Job Type: Full-Time Job Summary: We are looking for a skilled and creative Graphic Designer and Video Editor to join our dynamic team at Digital Mantraaz, a leading digital marketing agency. The ideal candidate will have a passion for design and visual storytelling, with the ability to create compelling graphics and engaging video content that drives our clients' digital marketing campaigns. The role involves working closely with the marketing, social media, and content teams to produce high-quality visual content that resonates with target audiences and enhances brand presence across digital platforms. Key Responsibilities: Graphic Design: Design eye-catching and innovative graphics for digital marketing campaigns, including social media posts, email templates, banner ads, and website visuals. Create graphics for various digital platforms, ensuring consistency with each clients brand identity. Collaborate with marketing strategists to understand campaign goals and translate them into visually compelling assets. Develop branded visuals for landing pages, PPC ads, and social media profiles. Stay current with the latest design trends and tools to create fresh, appealing content for digital audiences. Video Editing: Produce and edit video content for social media, advertisements, YouTube, and other digital channels, ensuring each piece is optimized for the intended platform. Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to brainstorm, storyboard, and develop video content that drives engagement and conversions. Edit promotional, instructional, and short-form video content, adding necessary effects, animations, and transitions. Incorporate motion graphics, typography, and visual effects to enhance video projects. Optimize video content for different social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, etc.), understanding the format and content strategies for each. Campaign Asset Development: Adapt and create new digital assets for various advertising platforms (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.). Design thumbnails, end screens, and overlays for video campaigns to enhance engagement and click-through rates. Work with performance marketing teams to iterate on design concepts that drive better results based on data-driven feedback. Branding and Consistency: Ensure all visual content aligns with each client's brand guidelines and overall marketing strategy. Maintain consistency in tone, style, and messaging across all graphic and video content. Participate in brainstorming sessions to offer creative solutions and concepts for marketing campaigns. Requirements: Proven experience as a Graphic Designer and Video Editor in a digital marketing environment, with a portfolio showcasing successful projects. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro) or equivalent tools for graphic design and video editing. Solid understanding of visual design principles, typography, color theory, and layout for both static and motion content. Experience creating digital assets for social media platforms and digital ads, with knowledge of best practices for each platform. Strong understanding of video production and editing techniques, including animation and motion graphics. Ability to work under tight deadlines, manage multiple projects, and pivot quickly based on client or campaign needs. Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with clients and internal teams. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Multimedia Arts, Visual Communication, or a related field. Experience working in a digital marketing agency or with brands in the digital marketing space. Knowledge of SEO and content marketing strategies is a plus. Understanding of marketing performance metrics and data-driven design. What We Offer: Competitive salary based on experience. Opportunity to work with a diverse range of brands and industries. A collaborative, creative work environment with room for professional growth. 
 Regards, HR Department
